hassio_confirm.title: Use Hearth Pi for Assist
hassio_confirm.description: Link Home Assistant Assist to the {addon} app? Hearth then appears as a conversation agent you can choose in a voice assistant. Hearth's own Home permissions and approvals decide every change; voice never approves anything.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Hearth. Check that the app is running and Assist is enabled in its configuration.
error.invalid_auth: Hearth did not accept the link. Restart the Hearth app so it publishes the link again.

abort.already_configured: Hearth is already linked; the link was updated.
abort.invalid_discovery: The Hearth app published an invalid link.
abort.use_discovery: Hearth is set up automatically from the Hearth Pi app. Set assist_enabled: true in the app's configuration and restart it.
